title: AFM Tip Functionalization with Glutaraldehyde
author: George Lykotrafitis
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.zzuf76w

steps.title: Silanize tip with APTES
steps.instruction: Treat the tip with 2 % v/v 3‑aminopropyltriethoxysilane (APTES) in acetone for 10 min at 25 °C.

steps.title: Rinse tip with DI water
steps.instruction: Rinse the tip thoroughly with deionized (DI) water.

steps.title: Immerse tip in glutaraldehyde
steps.instruction: Place the tip in 0.5 % v/v glutaraldehyde solution prepared in DI water and incubate for 30 min at 25 °C.

steps.title: Rinse tip with DI water
steps.instruction: Rinse the tip thoroughly with deionized (DI) water.

steps.title: Incubate tip in protein solution
steps.instruction: Incubate the tip in a protein solution at 100–300 µg/mL (e.g., 100 µg/mL αvβ3 protein) for 30 min at 25 °C.

steps.title: Rinse tip with DI water
steps.instruction: Rinse the tip thoroughly with deionized (DI) water.

steps.title: Block aldehyde groups with BSA
steps.instruction: Treat the probe with 100 µg/mL bovine serum albumin (BSA) in tris‑buffered saline (TBS) for 1 min at 25 °C to block remaining aldehyde groups.

steps.title: Store functionalized tips
steps.instruction: Store the functionalized tips at 4 °C in phosphate‑buffered saline (PBS) for up to 3 days.
